description: The plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for three different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8)” and has a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A red line with star-shaped markers represents “On-policy RL”, starting at approximately 74.5 when Temperature is 0.1, rising to a peak of 79.5 when Temperature is 0.7, and ending at approximately 77.0 when Temperature is 1.0. A maroon line with star-shaped markers represents “LUFFY”, starting at approximately 76.0 when Temperature is 0.1, declining to approximately 72.0 when Temperature is 0.5, rising to approximately 78.0 when Temperature is 0.7, and ending at approximately 76.5 when Temperature is 1.0. A teal line with triangle-shaped markers represents “SFT”, starting at approximately 73.0 when Temperature is 0.1, rising to approximately 76.0 when Temperature is 0.5, declining to approximately 72.0 when Temperature is 0.7, and ending at approximately 74.0 when Temperature is 1.0.
